Description

Amazon EC2 Hardware Engineering designs and builds the servers that power Amazon Web Services. We take the silicon our partners create and design the boards, servers, and racks around it, then own the full lifecycle: new product introduction (NPI), design validation, launch, manufacturing ramp, and in-fleet sustaining engineering across compute, storage, networking, edge, and accelerator products.

We are looking for a world-class engineering leader (Director, Hardware Development) to own a server product line end to end. This is a hands-on hardware-engineering leadership role: your organization owns the hardware design, system integration, and system engineering for a product family, and is accountable for delivering it from design through volume manufacturing and into a large-scale global fleet that must run reliably for years.

This is a leadership role with exceptional surface area. The space is broad, and the depth is multilayered: you will lead multiple teams through their managers, set multi-year technical and product strategy for your product line, operate deep in the engineering when it matters, and work externally with ODMs and vendors at a detailed technical level to drive roadmaps and secure supply. You will partner with the component and firmware teams your products depend on, and with Principal and Distinguished Engineers and senior leaders across AWS. The problems are hard, the scale is among the largest in the world, and the work is visible to the most senior leaders at AWS.

Key job responsibilities

As The Director, Hardware Development, You Will

Own a server product family end to end: hardware design, system integration, and system engineering, from NPI (New Product Introduction)and design validation through launch, manufacturing ramp, and in-fleet sustaining.
Own hardware quality and velocity for your product line, and be accountable for manufacturing yield and throughput targets and for resolving manufacturing-engineering defects.
Lead multiple engineering teams through their managers; hire, grow, and develop managers and engineers, and scale the organization to meet an aggressive roadmap.
Set the multi-year technical and product strategy for your product line and make long-term engineering decisions that balance innovation with reliability at scale.
Manage strategic relationships with ODM design and manufacturing partners (domestic and overseas)
Own fleet-reliability outcomes for your products (annualized failure rate, unsellable reduction, proactive defect remediation).
Partner across hardware, firmware, software, operations, and supply chain, and drive external roadmaps with partner teams.

A day in the life

You will work on problems that do not have textbook answers and where the questions themselves may not even be known. How do you take a new accelerator, compute, or storage server from a concept through qualification and ramp at an ODM, and into a global fleet that fails less than a fraction of a percent of the time over a ten-year life? How do you re-architect a design to hit manufacturing throughput targets for hundreds of thousands of units with minimal waste? How do you qualify a second source for a critical component to de-risk supply without slipping a launch? You will take hardware from a whiteboard sketch through design, manufacturing, and deployment at a scale almost nowhere else can offer.

About The Team

EC2 Hardware Engineering is organized along a vertical (product) and horizontal (component and firmware) axis. Vertical teams own whole server products end to end; the horizontal teams own the cross-cutting components and firmware every product depends on. This role leads one of the vertical product organizations. We invest in bringing new members up to speed, and we think about each engineer's growth when we assign work.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or commensurate experience
10+ years of hardware development experience
8+ years of engineering management experience
Experience delivering complex integrated hardware systems (servers, racks, or comparable electro-mechanical/compute systems) from design through volume manufacturing
Experience owning the full product lifecycle: NPI, design validation, launch, manufacturing ramp, and in-field sustaining
Experience partnering with product/program management and operating hardware at scale

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing and delivering datacenter server and/or rack systems at hyperscale
Deep experience in one or more of: board/system design, PCIe and high-speed signal integrity, power delivery and thermal, accelerator (GPU) systems, x86/ARM compute, or storage (HDD/SSD) systems
Design-for-manufacturing expertise; experience managing ODM partners (domestic and overseas) and component multi-sourcing/qualification
Experience operating a hardware fleet at scale: telemetry, real-time health, annualized-failure-rate reduction, and sustaining engineering
Experience with taking new greenfield technology initiatives or cutting-edge development to large scale production of integrated systems
Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a relevant engineering discipline

Trabus Technologies (TRABUS) is a minority-owned, service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) headquartered in San Diego, providing advanced wireless technology solutions, cybersecurity expertise, artificial intelligence, data science, and software engineering capabilities to federal and commercial clients since 2010. Our diverse technical strengths span emerging wireless innovations and engineering support to the armed services.

TRABUS has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list over the years, reflecting our continued growth and commitment to delivering innovative, mission-focused solutions to our customers.

POSITION SUMMARY

TRABUS has an opportunity for a Senior Software Development Engineer/Manager to lead the architecture, design, and implementation of core software components for next-generation Software-Defined Radio (SDR) wireless mesh networking systems. In this role, you will drive the development of resilient ad-hoc mesh networking protocols, architect zero-trust encryption frameworks, and optimize embedded database storage for real-time edge performance in mission-critical environments.

RESPONSIBILITIES

·        Lead the technical design and optimization of tactical routing algorithms, dynamic topology discovery, and low-latency networking protocols for resilient SDR mesh networks.

·        Architect and implement end-to-end cryptographic frameworks, key management protocols (KMP), and secure boot/data-at-rest solutions tailored for low-bandwidth or contested RF environments.

·        Design and tune lightweight embedded database systems such as SQLite, DuckDB, LMDB, or custom time-series engines to manage high-throughput packet logging, state tracking, and local data persistence under tight memory limits.

·        Write production-grade, low-latency C/C++ or Rust software targeted for Linux-based SDR hardware, taking ownership of subsystem performance from concept through field deployment.

·        Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, drive code reviews, lead technical trade studies, and collaborate closely with systems, RF, and hardware engineering teams.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

·        7+ years of professional software engineering & development management experience.

·        Advanced proficiency in modern C++ (20/23), C, or Rust.

·        Extensive experience with Layer 2/3 networking, TCP/IP, UDP, custom packet processing, and wireless mesh routing protocols such as OLSR, BATMAN-adv, or AODV.

·        Deep hands-on experience with cryptographic standards including AES-GCM, TLS 1.3, ECC, IPsec, NSA Type 1, or Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) standards.

·        Proven experience implementing and optimizing embedded relational, key-value, or time-series databases in constrained embedded systems.

·        Direct experience with SDR frameworks such as GNU Radio, UHD, or REDHAWK and RF physical-layer interactions.

·        U.S. Citizenship is required.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

·        Active DoD Security Clearance (Secret or Top Secret/SCI).

·        Experience with MIL-STD communications protocols, anti-jamming techniques, or low-probability-of-intercept/detection (LPI/LPD) waveforms.

·        Familiarity with containerization tools such as Docker or Podman and automated CI/CD workflows for secure embedded targets.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

·        Holidays

·        Health Insurance

·        Dental Insurance

·        Vision Insurance

·        Flexible Spending Account

·        401(k)

·        Life & AD&D Insurance

We are looking for an exceptional leader who views infrastructure through a product development lens.

Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven track record in designing systems and managing large-scale production infrastructure with a focus on networking, compute, or storage

Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Title: Sr Data Engineering Manager

This position is based in our Campbell, California offices. This position is on-site, full-time.

Why Imperative Care?

Do you want to make a real impact on patients?

As part of our team at Imperative Care, you can help elevate care for patients suffering from stroke and other devastating vascular diseases. Every day, the technologies that we develop at Imperative Care directly impact people at the most vulnerable moments of their lives. Our focus is on the needs of the patient, and they come first in everything we do.

What You’ll Do

The Sr. Data Engineering Manager serves as the subject matter expert in this field to build and lead the foundation of Imperative Care’s modern data architecture and AI capability. This includes technology such as Modern Data Platform, Enterprise AI, Agentic AI, and Semantic Data Architecture. This role is an individual contributor responsible for leading and establishing Imperative Care's semantic data warehouse and enterprise knowledge graph strategy (AI-ready enterprise data foundation) and through collaboration efforts, spearhead the development of practical agentic AI capabilities across Imperative Care’s core business areas and systems. This position designs and owns a modern, semantic data platform that unifies the company’s core business systems and unstructured content into a governed, connected data layer, and serves as the organization’s hands-on builder and corporate leader for agentic AI. This role will architect, build, pilot, and deploy a unified data platform and drive AI agents’ orchestration directly across core business systems, enabling governed analytics, business enabled self-service reporting, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents development, and workflow automation.

Modern Data Platform & Architecture

Design and own a modern, semantic data platform that connects key business systems—ERP, CRM, marketing technologies, contract/legal management software, purchasing, quality management, and business intelligence (e.g., tools such as QAD, Salesforce, HubSpot, Agiloft, Coupa, Propel, and Tableau)—together with unstructured and flat-file content, into a unified and governed data layer.
Evaluate and select the target architecture, weighing a semantic / knowledge-graph approach that connects data largely in place against a medallion / star-schema warehouse, and define the roadmap, build-vs-virtualize decisions, and total cost of ownership.
Build and maintain the knowledge graph and semantic layer using modern graph, semantic, and data-integration tooling (e.g., tools such as knowledge-graph platforms and data-sync / virtualization tools), enabling bi-directional sync, data cleansing, and master / reference data alignment.
Implement enterprise data security and governance using role- and attribute-based access control (RBAC / ABAC), along with data lineage, quality, and stewardship controls appropriate to a regulated environment.

Agentic AI & Intelligent Workflows

Serve initially as the hands-on builder—designing, prototyping, and deploying production AI agents and intelligent workflows that connect systems to actions and insights.
Build agent capabilities including tool / function calling, context and memory management, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Implement prompt-engineering and reasoning strategies, validate value through measurable outcomes, and iterate rapidly from pilot to production.
Partner with managed-service providers (MSPs) and vendors to scale agent development and workflow automation across business processes.

Business Enablement & Reporting

Empower business teams to self-serve analytics by providing the foundation of data, standards, and support that distributed report developers need.
Enable the business to build their own report and support data governance efforts. Where needed, lead the buildout of selected high-value reports directly.
Collaborate with data and analytics teams to improve data reporting, forecasting, and decision-support capabilities.

Leadership & AI Thought Leadership (Phased)

Act as an AI thought leader and change agent—driving adoption, educating stakeholders, and promoting a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision-making.
Translate fluently between technical and non-technical audiences and drive alignment across IT, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Quality.
Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and mentoring as the capability scales.

Quality, Governance & Compliance

Ensure solutions meet compliance and security expectations and are designed for scalability from the outset.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, or a related discipline and a minimum of 12 years of experience in data engineering / architecture, applied AI / ML, or enterprise application development; or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
Master’s degree preferred.
Demonstrated experience architecting modern data platforms—semantic layer and knowledge graph, and / or medallion / lakehouse—and integrating heterogeneous enterprise source systems and unstructured content.
Experience should include a minimum of 2 years of progressive recent, hands-on experience building production generative-AI and agentic solutions (LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG, orchestration, tool / function calling).
Knowledge of data governance and security models, including RBAC / ABAC, and of bi-directional data sync and data-cleansing patterns.
Proven ability to deliver pilots and proofs-of-concept end-to-end and scale them into production.
Experience in or alongside regulated environments—GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, computer system validation (CSV / CSA), GAMP 5, and HIPAA—strongly preferred.
Cloud infrastructure hands-on knowledge; experience managing vendors / MSPs (SOWs, licensing, budgets) preferred.
Effective communicator across technical and business audiences.

Employee Benefits
include a stake in our collective success with stock options, competitive salaries, a 401k plan, health benefits, generous PTO, and a parental leave program.

About The Role

Hippocratic AI builds safety-focused generative AI agents for healthcare: voice agents, care navigation, and patient engagement tools that work alongside clinicians to extend care beyond the hospital walls. Our platform is deeply integrated with health system technology, most centrally Epic, and increasingly Cerner (Oracle Health) and Athenahealth, so our agents can schedule, document, and coordinate care the same way a staff member would.

As Director of Integration Engineering, you’ll lead the team responsible for building and operating the technical connections between Hippocratic AI and every EHR and health system environment we work in. You’ll own the production integration and development shop end to end, including architecture, delivery, on-call reliability, and the engineering practices that keep partner go-lives on schedule and interfaces running cleanly in production.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and partner-side IT and interface teams to scope new integrations, keep existing ones healthy, and build a team and a process that scales as Hippocratic AI adds health system partners. You’ll manage engineers across the US and India, and you’ll be the executive point of accountability for integration delivery and production stability.

What You’ll Do

Lead the integration engineering function

Own the production integration and development shop for Hippocratic AI’s EHR connectivity, covering Epic (Interconnect, Bridges, App Orchard/Vendor Services APIs), Cerner (Oracle Health), and athenahealth, plus HL7 v2 interface feeds and flat file exchanges with partner health systems.
Set technical direction and delivery standards for the integration team, balancing new partner go-lives against the stability of integrations already in production.
Lead and grow a distributed engineering team spanning the US and India, including hiring, performance management, on-call rotation design, and day-to-day prioritization across time zones.
Establish engineering practices for code review, branching strategy, release cadence, and incident response, using GitHub and Jira as the backbone for source control, change tracking, and work management.
Set standards for the team’s engineering toolkit (Python-based data transformation, integration engines such as InterSystems IRIS and Redox, and CI/CD pipelines) and make the build-vs-buy calls on when to use each.
Partner with Product and Partnerships to scope new integration work, size effort accurately, and commit to go-live timelines the team can hit.

Own EHR and interoperability architecture

Maintain deep technical fluency in Epic’s integration technologies (FHIR/REST APIs, HL7v2 interfaces, Interconnect) and apply the same rigor to Cerner (Oracle Health) and athenahealth integrations as those partnerships grow.
Direct architecture decisions for HL7 v2 messaging, flat file interfaces, and modern API-based integrations (FHIR/REST), guiding the right method for each partner’s capabilities and constraints alongside the architects.
Guide the team’s use of integration engines (InterSystems IRIS, Redox) and FHIR bulk data workflows, and push toward reusable components and templates that speed up future go-lives.
Ensure every production interface has monitoring, alerting, and a clear escalation path, and drive root-cause fixes, not workarounds, when interfaces fail.
Maintain a current, defensible map of every live integration, its data flows, and its dependencies, so the team can answer “what happens if this changes” for any partner on short notice.
Track Epic, Cerner, and athenahealth platform changes (API deprecations, new interoperability mandates, vendor portal requirements) and keep the roadmap ahead of them.

Location and Travel

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week. Given the team’s footprint across the US and India, some flexibility for early or late meetings to overlap with the India-based team is expected, along with periodic travel to partner health systems and occasional overnight or out-of-state trips to support go-lives and escalations.

What You Bring

Must-Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years in healthcare integration engineering, with hands-on experience integrating against Epic (required); Cerner (Oracle Health) and/or athenahealth experience strongly preferred.
3+ years managing a production integration and/or software development team, including on-call ownership for live interfaces.
Deep, working knowledge of HL7 v2 messaging, flat file interface design, and modern API-based integration patterns (REST, FHIR), along with working knowledge of X12 transactions, across EHR ecosystems.
Proven experience running engineering delivery with GitHub (source control, code review, branching strategy) and Jira (sprint planning, issue tracking, release management).
Experience managing engineers across distributed, multi-time-zone teams, including the US and India.
Track record of taking health system integrations live on schedule and keeping them stable in production, including incident response and root-cause resolution.
Working knowledge of Python-based development and at least one integration engine (InterSystems IRIS), sufficient to review architecture and unblock the team on technical decisions.
Comfort working directly with internal teams as well as partner IT, interface, and clinical informatics teams during scoping, build, and go-live.

Nice-to-Have

added.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the operations and evolution of our Databricks analytics platform and broader business intelligence ecosystem.

This role will serve as a technical platform owner for Databricks, with particular focus on Databricks AI/BI and Genie, while also ensuring the reliable operation, governance, and lifecycle management of our existing enterprise BI platforms, including Spotfire, Tableau, Qlik, and Power BI.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on Databricks platform administration experience with expertise in modern analytics, AI/BI, governance, and enterprise BI technologies. This individual will help evolve the organization from traditional dashboard-based analytics toward governed, metadata-driven, conversational and self-service analytics experiences.

Responsibilities

Administer, operate, and continuously improve the enterprise Databricks platform, ensuring a secure, reliable, scalable, and well-governed analytics environment.
Manage Databricks workspace configuration, access and entitlements, compute and SQL warehouses, Unity Catalog integration, platform policies, monitoring, performance, and cost optimization.
Establish and maintain platform standards, operational procedures, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management for Databricks analytics capabilities.
Serve as the technical lead and platform specialist for Databricks AI/BI and Genie, driving the design, configuration, governance, deployment, and adoption of conversational analytics capabilities.
Partner with data product owners, engineers, analysts, and data stewards to ensure Genie has the metadata, semantic context, business definitions, trusted data products, and governance required to deliver reliable answers.
Develop standards and reusable patterns for Genie and AI/BI, including semantic definitions, instructions, example queries, trusted assets, access controls, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement of response quality.
Own and maintain the broader enterprise BI platform ecosystem, including Spotfire, Tableau, Qlik, and Power BI, ensuring platform availability, security, access management, upgrades, integrations, licensing, performance, and vendor support.
Rationalize BI platform usage, establish enterprise standards, and reduce unnecessary tool fragmentation while supporting existing business-critical analytics solutions.
Ensure tight integration between Databricks, Unity Catalog, transformation and semantic layers, and downstream BI and analytics experiences.
Partner with Enterprise Data Governance, Security, Infrastructure, and domain data teams to establish appropriate platform controls, policies, and operating models.
Monitor platform usage, adoption, performance, reliability, and cost, and use these insights to continuously improve the analytics platform experience.
Evaluate and implement emerging Databricks and analytics capabilities where they can improve self-service, governance, productivity, or user experience.
Act as a technical escalation point and trusted advisor for analytics platform capabilities across the organization.
Drive adoption of modern analytics capabilities while maintaining reliable support for existing enterprise BI platforms.

Qualifications

BS degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
5–8+ years of experience in data platforms, analytics platforms, business intelligence, or related technical roles.
3+ years of experience administering or operating enterprise-scale analytics or data platforms.
Strong hands-on experience administering Databricks environments, including workspace administration, identity and access management, compute, SQL warehouses, platform configuration, monitoring, security, and operational support.
Strong experience with Unity Catalog, including catalogs, schemas, permissions, governance, lineage, and integration with enterprise data governance practices.
Experience with Databricks AI/BI and Genie, or strong experience with comparable conversational analytics, semantic-layer, or natural-language-query technologies.
Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling, analytics engineering, and modern data architecture.
Experience operating and supporting enterprise BI platforms such as Spotfire, Tableau, Qlik, and Power BI. Deep expertise in every platform is not required, but candidates should have demonstrated experience administering and supporting enterprise BI technologies.
Understanding of semantic modeling, metadata management, data lineage, and how business context enables AI-powered analytics.
Experience with platform monitoring, performance optimization, incident/problem management, release management, and cost optimization.
Experience with automation, APIs, scripting, infrastructure-as-code, or CI/CD for data and analytics platforms preferred.
Experience working in regulated industries such as biotechnology or pharmaceuticals preferred.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate business analytics needs into scalable platform capabilities.
